warnings.message: Notification from block DMA of type DMA were dropped. This can cause corresponding data to be incorrect.
Current NEFF is missing compiler metrics. Please re-compile using latest version of the compiler

Missing HLO stats in the NEFF, `model_flops` and `mfu_hlo_estimated_percent` summary metrics will not be available. Consider the metrics (hardware_flops - transpose_flops) and mfu_inst_estimated_percent instead.

Missing additional dynamic DMA metadata, reported DMA values may be inaccurate. To enable more accurate DMA data, re-capture with --enable-dge-notifs flag or set NEURON_RT_ENABLE_DGE_NOTIFICATIONS=1 before running. Note: DGE notifications are disabled by default as they can cause execution timeouts on some models.

instruction_flop_schema.field_description: Number of floating-point operations (FLOPs) performed by this instruction. Each MAC (multiply-accumulate) operation counts as 2 FLOPs (one multiply, one add). Note that as each FP32 matmul lowers to two FP32_LO_HI instructions, each FP32_LO_HI matmul records half the logical FLOPs.

instruction_flop_schema.field_description: BF16-equivalent FLOPs for this instruction. Scales FLOPs to the BF16 throughput equivalent so the result can be used with BF16 peak throughput as the denominator for PE utilization calculations. BF16, FP16, and TF32 use a 1.0x multiplier. FP32 uses 4.0x. On Trn2/Trn3, FP8@FP8 and UINT8@UINT8 matmuls use 0.5x; FP8 or UINT8 mixed with a higher-precision operand uses 1.0x (executes at BF16 throughput). FP8 uses 1.0x on Trn1/Inf2. MXFP8 and MXFP4 use 0.25x on Trn3.

caveats: Profiled execution is for attribution; use unprofiled phase timing for throughput.
Active fractions are independently derived for each physical core and graph.
Instruction-duration sums overlap and cannot be treated as operation wall times.
Missing DMA notifications and dropped packets preclude an exact HBM bound.
HLO/kernel attribution requires nonempty source fields; no names are inferred from DMA counts.
